**Palletizing test result — Cell E2: 20/24 boxes in 05:56 of robot time**

**Bottom line:** I did not hit the 24-box target, and I want to explain why — and why I ran the test the way I did.

1. Re-run this test once the D1 hinge/panel is repaired and the door can close legitimately — at 1000 mm/s, 24 boxes in 6 minutes should be comfortably achievable (~4:30 of cycle time).

3. Treat 20/24 as the valid benchmark for any test run while the door interlock is active.
